It is near zero on the same compound written as one token (windshield, medication, glucose, indoor, sandbox, waterfront), on the completion pieces of split words (shield, mill, oor, ications, way, bolt), on ordinary concrete nouns and rare words outside the family (stone, river, table, window, house, book, city, money, zeugma), and on its lowercase material words in plain singular use (water, ice, sand, glass, air, ground, ash), which only reach a weak 0.5-1.1 band.
